mapper.insert: INSERT INTO orders (amount,status,created_at,updated_at) VALUES ( #{amount}, #{status}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP )
mapper.update: UPDATE order_db.orders SET status = 'AWAITING_INVENTORY', updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{orderId} AND status = 'CREATED'
UPDATE order_db.orders SET status = 'AWAITING_PAYMENT', updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{orderId} AND status = 'AWAITING_INVENTORY'
UPDATE order_db.orders SET status = 'CONFIRMED', updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{orderId} AND status = 'AWAITING_PAYMENT'
UPDATE order_db.orders SET status = 'CANCELLED', updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{orderId} AND status IN ( 'AWAITING_INVENTORY', 'AWAITING_PAYMENT' )
mapper.select: SELECT o.id AS order_id, o.amount, o.status, o.created_at, o.updated_at, oi.sku, oi.qty FROM orders o LEFT JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id WHERE o.id = #{id}
